Two skydivers collide in freak midair SoCal horror

A pair of skydivers were killed after colliding in midair during a jump in Riverside County.

Actual Article Body:

Two skydivers plunged to their deaths after colliding midair in a horrifying Southern California accident Friday.

The pair were rushed to a hospital after the reported midair collision in Lake Elsinore but neither survived, the Riverside County Sheriff’s Office confirmed to the California Post. Deputies responded to the 20000 block of Cereal Street at 11:47 a.m. after receiving a report of an air emergency.

“Upon arrival, deputies located two skydivers on the ground receiving medical aid,” said Sheriff’s Lt. Deirdre Vickers. “Both subjects were transported to a local hospital in critical condition, where they were later pronounced deceased.”

Firefighters also responded to the scene, with Cal Fire/Riverside County Fire Department.

Both skydivers suffered major traumatic injuries and were taken by ground ambulance for further care, the fire department told the Post. No other injuries were reported.

Video from the scene showed emergency vehicles and first responders gathered at an airfield as authorities investigated the fatal incident, per KTLA.

Witnesses told the outlet the skydivers had collided just 50 feet above the ground. An airport representative said that operations would resume once the scene was cleared.

The victims’ identities have not been released, and officials have not disclosed further details about their jumps or the moments before they were found critically injured.

“This investigation is ongoing, and no further details are available at this time,” Vickers said.
